main_text.p: illius nomen receptum omnibus. De fide, de consolatione, de fine et usu legis, de Christi officio, de nostra impotentia, de spiritu, de peccati latitudine, de vera operum perfectione, de gratia ac gratuita Christiani hominis iustificatione & libertate, in quibus ceu cardine, summa nostrę professionis vertitur, nulla tradebatur mentio. Theologia ad paucos atqș in tra scholas redacta ad argutias delapsa est. Pro Paulo, pro Petro Aquinas ac Scotus successit in manus hominū. Mundus relicto spirituali evangelicæ philosophiæ vigore ad externas ceremonias ac humanas traditiū unculas totus obstupuit. In his omnes fere constituebantur Christianę perfectionis numeri, ex his omnis pendebat consequendæ salutis fiducia, his ita omnia tribuebantur, ut vix aliud in templis conspiciebatur, in coenobiis tractabatur, in vita agitabatur, præter umbraticas quasdam cerę

page.notes: Page is a little soiled; some letters in the scan are damaged (e.g. "tradebatur", "perfectione") and transcribed as printed, with the long s and u/v normalised. The right-margin mark is not text.
